scenario.name: synthetic-tachyon-digital-environment
scenario.description: Explicit test inputs only; no actual NONMAIN, calibration, battery, or GPIO trace has been captured.
notes: GPIO ICLR readback is an explicit unverified fixture because the original firmware performs a read-modify-write of a write-only register.
Factory bytes are zero-filled synthetic input, not plausible per-device calibration proof.
No ROM boot or NONMAIN security validation is simulated before the application's reset vector.

note: Complete source image reset, IRQ/UART commands and fresh-boot persistence in the explicit synthetic MCU environment; finite scenarios, not universal equivalence.
